verdict.rationale: Anytype's Bookmark feature lets you paste a URL and auto-fetches title, description, preview image and favicon as an Object (anytype-docs-53), which is a rudimentary capture mechanism, but there is no evidence of an official browser extension/clipper for capturing full article text or highlights directly from the browser into notes.  missing for 10: dedicated browser extension/clipper, full-page/article content capture, highlight capture, any independent/community confirmation of a clipping workflow.
